references.text: The people of Israel crossed the Red Sea on dry ground, just as they later crossed the Jordan on dry ground
The Israelites walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground, just as they walked through the middle of the Jordan on dry ground
The prophecy that the waters would stop when the priests carried the ark down into the Jordan
The priests stood in the middle of the Jordan until all the people had crossed over, continuing this account
When the priests with the ark came up out of the Jordan, the water flowed back
The psalm celebrates God's power over the Jordan, which fled when Israel crossed
The crossing of the Jordan is compared to the crossing of the Red Sea
Hebrews refers to the act of faith when Israel crossed the Red Sea on dry ground, as reflected in the crossing of the Jordan
